# Agent sessions API

Manage conversation state. Creating a session record alone does not start an AI run. Use the Adios application or MCP integration to start agent work.

Use [API authentication](authentication.md) for protected requests. Examples use your own resource IDs and a temporary token; saved response examples are synthetic.

| Method | Path | Operation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/v1/agent_session` | [List agent sessions](#op-get-v1-agent-session) |
| `POST` | `/v1/agent_session` | [Create agent session](#op-post-v1-agent-session) |
| `GET` | `/v1/agent_session/{id}` | [Get agent session](#op-get-v1-agent-session-id) |
| `PUT` | `/v1/agent_session/{id}` | [Update agent session](#op-put-v1-agent-session-id) |
| `DELETE` | `/v1/agent_session/{id}` | [Delete agent session](#op-delete-v1-agent-session-id) |
| `GET` | `/v1/agent_session/{id}/state` | [Get agent session state](#op-get-v1-agent-session-id-state) |
| `GET` | `/v1/agent_session/{id}/plan` | [Get agent session plan](#op-get-v1-agent-session-id-plan) |
| `POST` | `/v1/agent_session/{id}/runs/{run_id}/cancel` | [Cancel agent run](#op-post-v1-agent-session-id-runs-run-id-cancel) |

## List agent sessions {#op-get-v1-agent-session}

`GET /v1/agent_session`

Returns a paginated list of AgentSession

Authentication: bearer token and the team header shown below.

### Parameters

| Name | Location | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `X-Tenant-ID` | header | yes | Active team ID. Must match the tenant bound to a diagnostic token. |
| `page` | query | no | Page number |
| `per_page` | query | no | Items per page |

### Request example

Set `ADIOS_API_URL=https://api.adios.dev`. For protected requests, set `ADIOS_ACCESS_TOKEN` and `ADIOS_TEAM_ID` as in the [quickstart](quickstart.md). Set any additional `ADIOS_*` variables from your own resource results.

```sh
curl --fail-with-body --request GET "$ADIOS_API_URL/v1/agent_session" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADIOS_ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Tenant-ID: $ADIOS_TEAM_ID"
```


### Response: HTTP 200

List of AgentSession

### Response fields

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | array |  |
| `data[].agent_session_id` | string |  |
| `data[].channel_id` | string |  |
| `data[].company_project_id` | string |  |
| `data[].context_snapshot` | object |  |
| `data[].created_at` | integer |  (Unix timestamp) |
| `data[].deleted_at` | integer |  (Unix timestamp) |
| `data[].last_message_at` | integer |  (Unix timestamp) |
| `data[].memory_summary` | object |  |
| `data[].metadata` | object |  |
| `data[].mode` | string |  Allowed: build, debug, ops, review, chat. |
| `data[].model` | string |  |
| `data[].owner_id` | string |  |
| `data[].provider` | string |  |
| `data[].sharing_scope` | string |  Allowed: private, team. |
| `data[].source` | string |  Allowed: app, slack, cli. |
| `data[].status` | string |  Allowed: active, paused, blocked, complete, failed. |
| `data[].team_id` | string |  |
| `data[].thread_id` | string |  |
| `data[].updated_at` | integer |  (Unix timestamp) |
| `data[].workspace_id` | string |  |
| `data[].writable_repository_id` | string |  |
| `pagination` | object |  |
| `pagination.page` | integer | Current page number |
| `pagination.per_page` | integer | Number of items per page |
| `pagination.total` | integer | Total number of items |

## Create agent session {#op-post-v1-agent-session}

`POST /v1/agent_session`

Creates a new AgentSession

This request changes data or starts an action. Review the target and body before sending it.

Request fields (the body contains an editable example):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `channel_id` | string | no |  Default: `""`. |
| `company_project_id` | string | no |  Default: `""`. |
| `context_snapshot` | object | no |  |
| `last_message_at` | integer | no | (Unix timestamp) Default: `0`. |
| `memory_summary` | object | no |  |
| `metadata` | object | no |  |
| `mode` | string | yes |  Allowed: build, debug, ops, review, chat. Default: `"chat"`. |
| `model` | string | no |  Default: `""`. |
| `owner_id` | string | no |  Default: `""`. |
| `provider` | string | no |  Default: `""`. |
| `sharing_scope` | string | yes |  Allowed: private, team. Default: `"private"`. |
| `source` | string | yes |  Allowed: app, slack, cli. |
| `status` | string | yes |  Allowed: active, paused, blocked, complete, failed. Default: `"active"`. |
| `team_id` | string | yes |  |
| `thread_id` | string | no |  Default: `""`. |
| `workspace_id` | string | no |  Default: `""`. |
| `writable_repository_id` | string | no |  Default: `""`. |

Authentication: bearer token and the team header shown below.

### Parameters

| Name | Location | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `X-Tenant-ID` | header | yes | Active team ID. Must match the tenant bound to a diagnostic token. |

### Request example

Set `ADIOS_API_URL=https://api.adios.dev`. For protected requests, set `ADIOS_ACCESS_TOKEN` and `ADIOS_TEAM_ID` as in the [quickstart](quickstart.md). Set any additional `ADIOS_*` variables from your own resource results.

```sh
curl --fail-with-body --request POST "$ADIOS_API_URL/v1/agent_session" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADIOS_ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Tenant-ID: $ADIOS_TEAM_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data-binary @- <<'JSON'
{
  "team_id": "YOUR_TEAM_ID",
  "owner_id": "YOUR_USER_ID",
  "workspace_id": "YOUR_WORKSPACE_ID",
  "sharing_scope": "private",
  "source": "app",
  "mode": "chat",
  "status": "active"
}
JSON
```

Replace `YOUR_*` body placeholders before sending. The quoted heredoc keeps the JSON literal.

### Response: HTTP 201

AgentSession created
